items.notes: Tenant isolation contract (routing, credentials, cache/queue scoping, network quotas) supports shared-to-dedicated moves, but the excerpt does not cover migration or cutover coordination.
Explicitly says to bind the operation key to immutable request parameters and reject same-key/different-intent reuse.
Directly explains that durable scheduler/log state does not prove the external RPC, launch or side effect occurred.
Explains HTTP method idempotency is distinct from business-effect deduplication; supports duplicate-after-expiry test design but does not address key expiry or test cases.
Compares logical backup, physical backup and WAL replay; it does not define or distinguish RTO and RPO.
RPO/RTO boundaries and replica lag support why promotion is not deletion recovery, but the excerpt does not directly address promoting a replica.
Frames WAL/PITR and warns a WAL archive is not a working PITR procedure, but lists no base-backup/WAL artifacts.
Experiment-selection table for CPU, GC, pool and memory diagnostics; nothing on fan-out threshold probability or waiting for all calls.
Worked retain/hedge/split decision discusses hedging optional calls, but the excerpt does not state when hedging adds overload.
Directly explains closed-model feedback and coordinated omission hiding overload versus independently paced demand.
